svg.aria-label: Map of the 128 Boulder Lane parcel, turned so Route 128 runs along the bottom. The parcel runs along the north side of Route 128 to the Wenham line. Mapped wetlands cover its western part and a strip along its eastern edge. The state lists two certified vernal pools in the middle of the parcel and a third just across its northern line, on a residential lot the same owner holds next to Kennel Hill Drive. Houses on Kennel Hill Drive and Fieldstone Lane are to the west.
